title: Outlook: Manage Multiple Inbox Rules at Once
description: You will soon be able to manage multiple inbox rules at the same time. Select every rule or choose only the ones you want to update. You can then delete, enable, or disable the selected rules in one action. This makes it faster and easier to keep your rules organized. #newoutlookforwindows
